# virtual-bot-connect

> Kun's office model: a private network and personal butler, one device per office with agents as employees,
> and project memory as the asset to retain across tools. Grok Bot is the butler/general manager; Multica is
> the work hub and ledger in the verified example. Mailbox, wake-up, permissions and audit trail connect them.
> Documentation, a message spec and sanitized examples; optional adaptation playbook, no installer. MIT.

Start with docs/office-model.md to understand the reasoning. Only Grok Bot + Multica is verified; webhook
wake-up is in live testing. Dots, Muse, Cue and standalone local-agent integrations are untested. Automatic
Google Drive backups are in progress: Grok Bot every 2 days, Multica every 7 days. The schedules and recovery
are unverified; keeping the setup running after changing offices or the general manager is a design goal.
If a user explicitly asks to adapt the setup, read AGENTS.md and docs/primitives.md next.
